🌍 Global Security Outlook – 26 February 2026

⸻

NORTH AMERICA

🇺🇸 United States – Pentagon appeals court order blocking disciplinary action tied to a video involving Sen. Mark Kelly and alleged unlawful orders messaging.

🇺🇸 United States – DOJ arrests former U.S. Air Force pilot for allegedly providing defense services to the Chinese military.

🇺🇸 United States – U.S. military continues counternarcotics strikes against suspected drug-running vessels in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific.

🇺🇸 United States – Five U.S. service members injured after military aircraft strikes barrier during takeoff in the Philippines.

⸻

EUROPE

🇺🇦 Ukraine – Ukrainian officials to meet U.S. envoys in Geneva ahead of further trilateral talks with Russia.

🇪🇺 Europe – Defense spending across Europe rose at a record pace in 2025, outpacing Russian military outlays.

🇫🇷 France – Six New York National Guard members receive French valor awards for rescuing French special forces under fire in 2023.

⸻

MIDDLE EAST

🇸🇾 Syria – Authorities confirm mass escape of suspected Islamic State affiliates’ relatives from al-Hol detention camp after Kurdish forces withdrew.

🇾🇪 Yemen – U.S. congressional reporting highlights continued instability and Red Sea security risks linked to Iran-backed Houthi activity near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

⸻

ASIA-PACIFIC

🇵🇭 Philippines – U.S. military training aircraft accident injures multiple service members during takeoff operations.

🇨🇳 China – U.S. authorities charge former American pilot with providing military-related services to Chinese forces.

⸻

GLOBAL / MULTI-REGIONAL

🌍 NATO – Alliance integrates drones and unmanned systems into major exercises in the Baltic and Mediterranean seas.

🌍 Space – U.S. Space Force pauses all Vulcan rocket launches pending investigation into launch anomaly.

🌍 Defense Industry – U.S. unveils new hypersonic missile systems adaptable for air, ground, and potential space-based deployment.

🌍 United States – Navy aviation units and B-2 bomber rehearse anti-ship strike missions off California coast.

IN PHOTOS │Firefighters from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) conduct overhaul operations following a massive fire that gutted hundreds of homes in Barangay 655, Intramuros, Manila, on Thursday. The blaze destroys at least 300 houses and displaces around 600 families in the densely populated community. 

Authorities take a suspect into custody and conduct a further investigation into possible arson and reckless endangerment, while relief operations continue for affected residents. 

📸:  Norman Cruz
